description: Machine-readable dialect scenarios. Every entry is independently authored in this package from the referenced ScriptDOM script family; no fixture text is copied. A scenario declares what must be true, so a missing expectation is visible as missing rather than counted as passing.

classifications.valid: Parses structurally with no raw recovery, no syntax diagnostic, and no availability diagnostic on the declared profile.
classifications.unsupportedProfile: Parses structurally with no raw recovery and receives exactly the declared availability diagnostics.
classifications.invalid: A negative neighbour: it must still produce a syntax diagnostic rather than being absorbed by a permissive rule.
classifications.incomplete: A typing prefix: it must not throw and must keep every range inside the document.
